modules.title: Coastal flooding
modules.subtitle: Inundation depth & coastal change
modules.description: Explore coastal inundation depth for the 2018 baseline and the 2050 RCP8.5 projection, with 100-year depth-change and threshold-transition layers.
modules.source: CLIMAAX / Deltares · MERIT DEM · 90 m grid
modules.scope: Rectangular Alanya coastal screening window; not a district-wide administrative total.
notes: Model-based screening. Uncoloured locations may be below the display threshold or lack data.
The 2050 layers use RCP8.5; the map background does not represent land use in 2050.

modules.title: River flooding
modules.subtitle: Historical inundation depth
modules.description: Inspect the supplied JRC historical-climate flood-depth cells across nine return periods. Select a cell to read its source depth.
modules.source: JRC / CEMS · Native WGS84 source grid
modules.scope: Alanya and upstream screening window; different from the resident-exposure study polygon.
notes: Raw depths include permanent-water and suspicious-depth flag overlaps. QA exclusions are sensitivity cases, not validation.
Local JRC file release identity and mask semantics remain unverified in the supplied run.
Model-based screening. Uncoloured locations may be below the display threshold or lack data.

modules.title: Population exposure
modules.subtitle: Resident estimates & QA sensitivity
modules.description: Explore resident-population exposure to historical river T100 flooding. Switch between all exposed residents and the depth-based displacement proxy.
modules.source: Historical JRC river hazard + GHS population 2025 projection
modules.scope: OSM-derived Alanya study polygon. The interactive map is T100 only; the downloadable table contains T10–T500.
notes: Population 2025 is a projection. Seasonal visitors are not included.
The displacement proxy uses depth > 1 m; it is not a count of observed displaced people.
No monetary losses were computed. The OSM building/facility download failed, leaving that inventory incomplete.
QA filters change the included cells; they do not validate the remaining hazard.

modules.title: River discharge
modules.subtitle: Climate scenarios & model spread
modules.description: Compare Q10 and Q50 source-indicator changes across nine E-HYPE model subcatchments, two climate scenarios and three future periods.
modules.source: CLIMAAX / E-HYPE · Six available model members
modules.scope: Full model subcatchments intersecting the Alanya study polygon. These flows must not be summed across catchments.
notes: Discharge change describes river-flow indicators, not flood depth or inundation extent.
Projections were not validated against local gauge observations.
Period labels follow the source-indicator table. The period-label audit is available below.
